headline: Elena Marlowe and Tom Hargrove marry in a clifftop ceremony near Byron Bay
body: Actors Elena Marlowe and Tom Hargrove were married on Saturday in a small clifftop ceremony near Byron Bay, according to a statement from their publicist. About sixty guests watched the couple exchange vows at sunset, with the ocean behind them and white roses lining the aisle. Marlowe wore a long ivory gown with a lace veil, and Hargrove a charcoal suit. The pair, who met on the set of a television drama four years ago, announced their engagement last spring. A reception followed at a nearby farmhouse with live music and dancing late into the evening. The couple are expected to honeymoon in the Whitsundays.
